prompt_en: On a hat boi opera night at a village communal house, actors with painted faces, headdresses and long beards perform on a stage, with a praise drum at the side.
refined_prompt: On a hat boi opera night at a village communal house, actors with painted faces, headdresses and long beards perform on a stage, with a praise drum at the side. On a serene evening in an ancient Vietnamese village, villagers gather in the village communal house, known as a đình làng, to witness a traditional theatrical performance marking the Lunar New Year festival. The đình làng, an ancient structure adorned with elaborate wood carvings featuring mythical creatures and historical figures, and vibrant red and gold silk curtains with intricate patterns, stands as the heart of the village, symbolizing unity and heritage. Performers dressed in elaborate, symbolic costumes representing traditional Vietnamese theater take the stage, accompanied by the distinctive sound of a trống chầu, a small double-headed drum made from animal hide stretched over a hollowed-out wooden frame and decorated with intricate patterns, which produces a loud snapping sound when beaten with a long wooden stick. This rhythmic beat adds a vibrant energy to the performance, complementing the ao dai-clad audience who eagerly await the celebration of the Lunar New Year and honoring of ancestors.
